parameters.query:
SELECT 
    u.user_email,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.post_title ORDER BY p.post_title SEPARATOR ', ') AS aktive_abos
FROM wp_users u
INNER JOIN wp_posts s
    ON s.post_type = 'shop_subscription'
    AND s.post_status = 'wc-active'
INNER JOIN wp_postmeta sm
    ON sm.post_id = s.ID
    AND sm.meta_key = '_customer_user'
    AND sm.meta_value = u.ID
INNER JOIN wp_woocommerce_order_items oi
    ON oi.order_id = s.ID
INNER JOIN wp_woocommerce_order_itemmeta oim
    ON oim.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
    AND oim.meta_key = '_product_id'
INNER JOIN wp_posts p
    ON p.ID = oim.meta_value
    AND (
        p.post_title LIKE '%Liebesbüchse%'
        OR p.post_title LIKE '%Zauberbüchse%'
        OR p.post_title LIKE '%Dunkelbüchse%'
    )
    AND p.post_title NOT LIKE '%Goodie%'
GROUP BY u.user_email
ORDER BY u.user_email
